_provenance_note: Hand-derived from the Go structs and the named Go test at Prior 12d8424, not emitted by Go. Revision, EvidenceHash, SnapshotHash and CharterHash were computed by codec/src/prior/gojson.ts (computePriorRevision, computeEvidenceHash, computeSnapshotHash, computeCharterHash), which reproduces encoding/json; the Prior side replaces this file with a Go-emitted golden (plan FJ00 step 12). Keys beginning with an underscore are not Go fields and are stripped before mapping; _inputs holds the call inputs (Policy, Snapshot, FormationPolicy, CompletionEvidence, WorkItems) that Prior does not persist in the aggregate.
